full_judgment: 44. It is true when LTIs on a document are admitted the author of such LT1s is required to prove the circumstances in which the document was brought into existence. Registration of a document also raises a presumption of regularity. But the above circumstances as brought on record sufficiently rebutted the presumption and shifted the onus on the defendant no. I to prove that said women executed and registered the deed of gift giving up their entire shares to him.
